summary: Welcome to an exclusive CDAO Circle lunch which starts with a plated lunch service at 12:45pm to 13:10pm. Please click here to see the menu. Overcoming a major barrier to AI adoption lies in our ability to trust AI actions and its ability to understand the world in which it operates. In this session we will discuss and share ideas on how to create the boundaries for autonomous action, based on Gartner research and your experiences.
